title: Production backend governance and advisor verification
summary: Read-only production reconciliation, post-deploy advisors, targeted governance tests, lint, and the complete application suite verify the current MED+250 backend boundary without retaining protected data.

checks.name: Description publication boundary
checks.detail: Production has zero incomplete approved descriptions, zero public description leaks, and zero approved descriptions lacking a matching current immutable audit event.

checks.name: Review privilege boundary
checks.detail: Anonymous and ordinary signed-in roles cannot inspect the review ledger or execute description decisions; the protected backend role retains the required access.

checks.name: Trust suppression boundary
checks.detail: The live aggregate response contains no identity or health data and suppresses both public values with approval_required until real operations approval exists.

checks.name: Database advisor verification
checks.detail: No new actionable MED+250 security defect was found, and both previously reported notification-outbox foreign-key performance notices are cleared.

checks.name: Complete regression suite
checks.detail: The serialized production build and complete Node regression suite passed 302 of 302 tests, including the new outbox-index contract test.

checks.name: Static verification
checks.detail: Lint, implementation-register validation, JSON validation, targeted database tests, and the scoped whitespace check all completed successfully.
